title: A Review of Fairness and a Practical Guide to Selecting Context-Appropriate Fairness Metrics in Machine Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretically evaluated using a prisoner recidivism case study to demonstrate a proposed context-based flowchart, which selects 'balanced group AUC' as the appropriate fairness metric due to unequal base rates and an emphasis on recall.

Theoretically evaluated using a CV evaluation case study to demonstrate the proposed context-based flowchart, which selects 'statistical parity' as the appropriate metric due to jurisdictional equity requirements.

Theoretically evaluated using a political email spam filtering case study to demonstrate the proposed context-based flowchart, which selects 'balanced group accuracy' based on assumed equal base rates and a dual emphasis on precision and recall.
